query_analysis.original_query: Please provide the thermodynamic data related to azeotropes existing in natural gas processing columns.
query_analysis.expanded_query: Retrieve and compile thermodynamic data pertaining to azeotropic mixtures that may form within natural gas processing columns.

clarification_questions: What is the specific composition of the natural gas being processed?
What are the typical operating conditions (temperature and pressure) within the processing columns?
Are there any specific azeotropes of interest?
